title.en: Structure and symbols of a BJT

heading.en: A device that changed the world

hook.en: In 1947 three scientists at Bell Labs built a tiny device that replaced the bulky vacuum tube. Today a phone chip holds billions of them.
hook.kn: 1947ರಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಲ್ ಲ್ಯಾಬ್ಸ್‌ನ ಮೂವರು ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳು ದೊಡ್ಡ ನಿರ್ವಾತ ನಳಿಕೆಯ ಬದಲಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಸಾಧನವನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸಿದರು. ಇಂದು ಒಂದು ಫೋನ್ ಚಿಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂತಹ ಕೋಟಿಗಟ್ಟಲೆ ಸಾಧನಗಳಿವೆ.

objectives.en: Describe the three regions of a BJT and their doping
Draw the symbols of NPN and PNP transistors

narration.en: In 1947 three scientists at Bell Labs built a tiny device that replaced the bulky vacuum tube. Today a phone chip holds billions of them.
narration.kn: 1947ರಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಲ್ ಲ್ಯಾಬ್ಸ್‌ನ ಮೂವರು ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳು ದೊಡ್ಡ ನಿರ್ವಾತ ನಳಿಕೆಯ ಬದಲಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಸಾಧನವನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸಿದರು. ಇಂದು ಒಂದು ಫೋನ್ ಚಿಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂತಹ ಕೋಟಿಗಟ್ಟಲೆ ಸಾಧನಗಳಿವೆ.

body.en: A bipolar junction transistor (BJT) is a three-layer semiconductor device: a thin base sandwiched between an emitter and a collector. In an NPN transistor a P-type base lies between N-type emitter and collector; in a PNP transistor an N-type base lies between P-type regions. It is called bipolar because both electrons and holes take part in conduction.

points.en: Emitter: heavily doped, medium size, supplies carriers
Base: very thin (a few micrometres) and lightly doped
Collector: moderately doped and largest, collects carriers and dissipates heat

narration.en: A BJT has three layers, emitter, base and collector, and two junctions. The emitter is heavily doped, the base is thin and lightly doped, and the collector is the largest.
narration.kn: ಬಿಜೆಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಮಿಟರ್, ಬೇಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕಲೆಕ್ಟರ್ ಎಂಬ ಮೂರು ಪದರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡು ಸಂಧಿಗಳಿವೆ. ಎಮಿಟರ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಡೋಪ್ ಆಗಿದೆ, ಬೇಸ್ ತೆಳುವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಡೋಪ್ ಆಗಿದೆ, ಕಲೆಕ್ಟರ್ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ದೊಡ್ಡದು.

title.en: On the board: Inside a BJT

say.en: A transistor is a sandwich of three layers. In an NPN transistor a thin P layer sits between two N layers.
The left layer is the emitter, the middle the base and the right the collector. Each has a lead.
Where the layers meet there are two p-n junctions: the emitter-base junction and the collector-base junction.
The emitter is heavily doped to supply carriers, the base is very thin and lightly doped, and the collector is the largest.

text.en: PNP: N base between P layers

say.en: In the symbol, the arrow on the emitter shows conventional current. For NPN it points out; for PNP it points in.
A memory trick: NPN means Not Pointing iN.

body.en: In the symbol, the emitter lead carries an arrow that shows the direction of conventional current in the emitter. For NPN the arrow points outward (away from the base); for PNP it points inward (towards the base). The collector and base leads have no arrow.

points.en: NPN: arrow out of the base
Arrow = direction of conventional emitter current

narration.en: The arrow is always on the emitter. It points out for NPN and in for PNP, showing the direction of conventional current.
narration.kn: ಬಾಣದ ಗುರುತು ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಎಮಿಟರ್ ಮೇಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಎನ್‌ಪಿಎನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅದು ಹೊರಮುಖವಾಗಿ, ಪಿಎನ್‌ಪಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳಮುಖವಾಗಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A transistor has its N-type region between two P-type regions. Identify its type and the direction of the arrow in its symbol.

steps.en: The middle layer is the base; here it is N-type.
Outer P-type layers are emitter and collector, so it is a PNP transistor.
In PNP, conventional current flows into the emitter, so the arrow points towards the base.

answer.en: PNP transistor; the emitter arrow points inward (towards the base).

narration.en: Let us work this out together. A transistor has its N-type region between two P-type regions. Identify its type and the direction of the arrow in its symbol.

heading.en: Which way does the arrow point?

body.en: For NPN the arrow is "Not Pointing iN"; for PNP the arrow "Points iN Proudly".

narration.en: Which way does the arrow point?. For NPN the arrow is "Not Pointing iN"; for PNP the arrow "Points iN Proudly".
Class quiz. Discuss with your neighbour, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the Karnataka PUC board pattern. Try them on your own before we check.

points.en: A BJT has three regions and two junctions.
points.kn: ಬಿಜೆಟಿಗೆ ಮೂರು ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡು ಸಂಧಿಗಳಿವೆ.

points.en: Emitter heavily doped, base thin and lightly doped, collector largest.
points.kn: ಎಮಿಟರ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಡೋಪ್, ಬೇಸ್ ತೆಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಡೋಪ್, ಕಲೆಕ್ಟರ್ ಅತಿ ದೊಡ್ಡದು.

points.en: The emitter arrow points out for NPN and in for PNP.
points.kn: ಎಮಿಟರ್ ಬಾಣ ಎನ್‌ಪಿಎನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊರಗೆ, ಪಿಎನ್‌ಪಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳಗೆ.

homework.en: Draw neat labelled symbols of NPN and PNP transistors and state why the collector is the largest region.

narration.en: Recap. A BJT has three regions and two junctions. Emitter heavily doped, base thin and lightly doped, collector largest. The emitter arrow points out for NPN and in for PNP.
